title: Parallelise internal/cli's 472 serial tests: the per-tick gate's floor
description:
Under -short, internal/cli is the gate's long pole: 154s of the uncached gate's 162s here, and 120s alone. Of that, 472 top-level tests run serially, summing ~78s, because 158 t.Setenv and 12 os.Chdir/t.Chdir lines bar t.Parallel(). The other ~40s is z7w's property tests, which zi6 owns. Thread the env and cwd inputs through the command's options, as yzk proposes for subprocess and herdr and as Options.Procs/Now already do, so the tests can join the parallel pack. With zi6, cli and so the gate should drop toward ~1 min. It does not move t8u's A1 (reconcile is that floor).
evidence: go test -short -count=1 -parallel 12 -json ./internal/cli/: wall 120s; serial top-level tests 472 summing 78.0s; grep -c 't.Setenv(' internal/cli/*_test.go = 158
